objective: Preserve the published 12.0 PIT stock alpha targets byte-for-byte, reject return-diluting risk overlays, and test a raw-price 100-share continuous account with exact group P&L reconciliation before opening any selection period.

corporate_action_source.economic_primary: CNInfo implementation records via pinned akshare.stock_dividend_cninfo
corporate_action_source.formal_scope: union of every candidate and ADV500 target ticker in the 12.0 development panel
corporate_action_source.formal_query_plan: CNInfo queried once per scope ticker; Tushare queried once per official ex_date from 2017-10-09 through 2023-01-03; both plans repeated independently and filtered to the 2252-ticker allowlist
corporate_action_source.availability_rule: CNInfo implementation_ann_date and Tushare imp_ann_date must be known and no later than ex_date; only effective event dates at or before t may affect t
corporate_action_source.primary_identity_rule: ticker+report_period+dividend_type+record/ex/pay/share-arrival dates; same identity with conflicting bonus/capitalization/cash economics fails
corporate_action_source.primary_amount_units: CNInfo values are per 10 shares and are divided by 10 exactly
corporate_action_source.secondary_role: Tushare normally supplies diagnostics and missing CNInfo share-arrival timing; its economics may book only under the globally frozen raw-reference fallback below

secondary_economic_fallback.reason: the pre-return candidate structural smoke stopped before producing any return because CNInfo omitted 28 Tushare ticker/ex-date actions across 8 tickers
secondary_economic_fallback.coverage_rule: consider a Tushare ticker/ex-date group only when CNInfo contains zero action for that ticker/ex-date
secondary_economic_fallback.stable_source_rule: the exact canonical Tushare action must be present in both byte-stable captures and implementation_ann_date must be no later than ex_date
secondary_economic_fallback.raw_bar_rule: the ticker must have positive finite close/adj_factor on the immediately previous official session and positive finite pre_close/adj_factor on ex_date
secondary_economic_fallback.ambiguity_rule: the uncovered ticker/ex-date must contain exactly one canonical Tushare economic action; multiple aggregate/component rows are ambiguous and fail without subset selection or summation
secondary_economic_fallback.reference_rule: test the unique action with (previous_close-pre-tax cash)/(1+stock ratio)
secondary_economic_fallback.admission: only groups passing every preceding rule book Tushare pre-tax cash, stock ratio and event timing; every canonical action in an admitted group is retained separately
secondary_economic_fallback.nonadmission: no factor jump, missing adjacent raw bars, reference mismatch, or any CNInfo same ticker/ex-date means Tushare economics are not added; a held unresolved factor jump or held action with missing adjacent bars still fails the phase

corporate_action_source.tushare_base_fields: base_date and base_share are retained only in the stable raw diagnostic response; per-share economics are never rescaled by them and they do not change canonical action identity
corporate_action_source.cash_policy: book 80% of CNInfo pre-tax cash per share at ex-date for both base and stress as a conservative maximum individual-investor withholding assumption
corporate_action_source.stock_policy: record-date settled shares earn each action independently; floor(entitled_shares * (bonus+capitalization)/10) to whole pending shares with zero assumed cash compensation
corporate_action_source.cash_timing: record-date shares earn a receivable on ex_date; receivable becomes cash on pay_date
corporate_action_source.share_arrival_fallback: if CNInfo share_arrival_date is absent, require one unique Tushare implemented row set with exact ticker/record/ex and total stock ratio; use its div_listdate, otherwise fail

rights_and_other_unmodeled_actions.policy: no complete rights source is available; any held/pending ticker adjustment-factor jump without a canonical CNInfo action fails the entire phase
rights_and_other_unmodeled_actions.event_session: exact official ex_date; no later favorable remapping
rights_and_other_unmodeled_actions.previous_price: raw daily.close on the immediately previous official session
rights_and_other_unmodeled_actions.theoretical_reference: (previous_close - sum(CNInfo pre-tax cash per share)) / (1 + sum((bonus+capitalization)/10))
rights_and_other_unmodeled_actions.unmodeled_adjustment_event_definition: with no canonical action, fail when abs(previous_close/provider_pre_close - 1) > 1e-12 or abs(adj_factor_t/adj_factor_prev - previous_close/provider_pre_close) > 0.0011
rights_and_other_unmodeled_actions.subthreshold_factor_drift: if previous_close equals provider_pre_close and factor-reference error is at most 0.0011, a nonzero adj-factor drift is counted and disclosed as provider precision drift but does not create cash or shares

diemeng_minute_source.wire_contract: HTTPS POST; apiKey header only; response code=200 and complete data.total/data.list pagination
diemeng_minute_source.formal_scope: only frozen execution-or-mark ticker/session/window pairs across all roles; A covers every settled/pending holding, B covers every surviving holding plus positive target, and C covers every surviving holding plus planned buy; no full-market history download
diemeng_minute_source.capture_range: 09:30:00 opening-price evidence plus 09:31:00 through 09:47:00 inclusive continuous-auction evidence
diemeng_minute_source.unit_inference: for each ticker/date slice independently, require exactly one combination of volume multiplier {1,100} and amount multiplier {1,1000} whose A/B/C five-minute aggregate VWAPs lie within their aggregate OHLC ranges by RMB0.01; these are the exact values consumed by execution: A 09:31..09:35, B 09:37..09:41 and C 09:43..09:47; every window must be either absent or contain all five exact rows, each raw row still passes timestamp/OHLC/nonnegative/zero-state checks, and 09:30/09:36/09:42 remain optional raw context excluded from unit validation; slices with no positive consumed-window liquidity have null units and are nontradable
diemeng_minute_source.phase_access_contract: the formal simulator first predicate-reads only the 09:30 opening evidence and reads signal/daily-limit context with zero minute IO for every role; it then advances all roles in lockstep and predicate-reads one union scope at a time in strict A, B, C order; no current-stage read may materialize or cache a later clock, an A response cannot contain B/C fields, and a B response cannot contain C fields
diemeng_minute_source.final_sentinel_access: predicate-read 09:30 opening evidence for economic holdings only; execution context and A/B/C reads are forbidden
diemeng_minute_source.phase_transition_fail_closed: duplicate, skipped, out-of-order, wrong-clock or future-window input aborts the whole boundary and restores the account/postings to the state before A planning
diemeng_minute_source.auction_anchor: for an economic holding, a 09:30 1min row normally must equal raw daily open within RMB0.005; the only mismatch allowed is a zero-volume, zero-amount, flat-OHLC row whose price equals raw daily pre_close within RMB0.005, which is classified as a provider pre-close placeholder and cannot override the authoritative raw daily open; every other mismatch fails, and 09:30 volume is never used for fill or capacity

stage_1_candidate_only.scope_rule: for each of all 22 raw-open boundaries including the final mark-only sentinel, capture the cumulative union of every candidate target seen through that signal, excluding a ticker only when execution_date >= its effective delist_date
stage_1_candidate_only.stop_without_stage_2_if_any_fail: candidate base/stress full/train/validation CAGR positive, fill, capacity, no cash/leverage/future/accounting violation, three size groups positive, industry positive/leave-one-out fractions, calendar-year fraction and non-both-positive behavior

stage_2_all_roles_only_after_stage_1_pas.scope_rule: mechanically derive the cumulative union of every candidate and ADV500 target through each of all 22 boundaries, including the final mark-only sentinel, excluding a ticker only when execution_date >= its effective delist_date; rules/thresholds/runner cannot change after stage 1
stage_2_all_roles_only_after_stage_1_pas.additional_gate: candidate_base CAGR above matching adv500_base in full/train/validation
stage_2_all_roles_only_after_stage_1_pas.stage_1_reuse: reference and reuse every stage-1 minute and price-limit artifact byte-for-byte; never re-query overlapping candidate pairs
stage_2_all_roles_only_after_stage_1_pas.candidate_replay_identity: stage-2 candidate base/stress orders, postings, daily NAV, periods, groups, metrics and result payload must equal stage 1 exactly

development_data_stages.stage_1_implementation_freeze: stage-1 result and manifest must freeze exact SHA-256 for the protocol, minute capture/verifier/store, corporate-action code, raw reader, target/metric/cost/suspension dependencies, real-share account, phased executor, simulation, scope generator, two-stage orchestration and stage-1 runner plus the complete raw source receipt/allowlist; because a formal stage-2 capture/runner is not yet implemented, even a passing stage 1 records stage_2_permitted=false; stage 2 can become permitted only after that implementation is frozen and stage 1 is replayed under the enlarged exact file-hash set
development_data_stages.pair_hash_algorithm: SHA256(JSON records, ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), allow_nan=false)

rejected_global_unit_calibration.rejection_reason: eight large-cap samples did not expose provider mixed volume regimes; 300630.SZ 2020-07-01 proves provider vol is already shares while 000001.SZ requires hands*100

rejected_per_slice_unit_calibration_v2.rejection_reason: formal candidate pair 002203.SZ on 2019-07-01 proved that the price-only 09:30 auction row can have rounded provider volume whose implied VWAP escapes its one-price anchor even though every 09:31..09:47 continuous bar has one strict unit

rejected_per_slice_unit_calibration_v3.rejection_reason: formal candidate pair 600064.SH on 2019-07-01 proved that unused 09:42 decision-overlap amount/volume can escape printed OHLC by just over one cent even though every consumed A/B/C bar has one strict unit

rejected_consumed_clock_unit_calibration.rejection_reason: formal candidate pair 002714.SZ on 2019-10-08 had one 09:32 raw minute whose implied VWAP escaped its individual high, while all three exact five-minute aggregates actually consumed by execution were strictly valid

accepted_consumed_window_aggregate_unit_.execution_window_row_rule: each A/B/C window has exactly zero or five rows; one through four rows fail
accepted_consumed_window_aggregate_unit_.context_clock_rule: 09:30, 09:36 and 09:42 may be present or absent and never validate units

diemeng_minute_source.coverage_start_policy: discover and attest separately for each ticker; never impose one universal start year or a 2016 cutoff

real_share_execution.price_basis: raw open for old-period boundary, VWAP aggregated from exact Diemeng 1min continuous-auction bars for trades, raw close for daily mark
real_share_execution.complete_liquidation_odd_lot_policy: sell the entire remaining position once; no partial odd-lot sale
real_share_execution.partial_sell_rounding: floor executable shares to the nearest lower 100-share lot; if full target is zero and the entire settled position is within capacity, sell all odd shares once
real_share_execution.buy_cash_scaling: after both prior sell windows have completed and proceeds are observable, size buys from the observable window-B close; reserve each order at its frozen limit price plus worst-case non-stamp costs, apply one common 48-iteration bisection cash scale, then floor every buy to 100 shares; C-window VWAP or volume cannot affect requested shares and residual cash is not redistributed
real_share_execution.execution_session: next official session in three causal five-minute windows aggregated from 1min bars; exact-open/auction execution is forbidden

execution_windows.A_full_exits: after raw-open company actions settle, target-zero settled positions are frozen at 09:30 and execute only over 1min labels 09:31..09:35; the 09:30 auction bar is excluded; VWAP=sum(amount_rmb)/sum(volume_shares)
execution_windows.A_observable_at: 09:36; mark surviving holdings at the first-bar close, use current after-A account NAV as the target-notional denominator, and only then compute partial reductions
execution_windows.B_partial_reductions: partial sells planned at 09:36 execute only over 1min labels 09:37..09:41; label 09:36 is excluded as pre-decision overlap
execution_windows.B_observable_at: 09:42; settle all window-B proceeds, mark holdings at the B close, use current after-B account NAV as the target-notional denominator, and only then size buys
execution_windows.C_buys: requested shares use B-close prices and a buy limit=min(daily up-limit, B close*1.01); buys planned at 09:42 execute only over 1min labels 09:43..09:47 when the entire C-window high is no greater than the frozen limit, using C VWAP
execution_windows.C_observable_at: 09:48; no sale in window C may fund another window-C order
execution_windows.complete_partition_but_no_bar_or_zero_vo: the affected order is blocked; no later bar, daily open, or substitute ticker
execution_windows.missing_or_unverified_partition: fail the entire phase before simulation; it is not an order-level block

real_share_execution.buy_limit_tick_rounding: floor B_close*(1+0.01) to the lower RMB0.01 tick, then min with exact daily up_limit
real_share_execution.daily_price_limit_source: two exact Tushare stk_limit captures for each execution session; missing ticker/date or disagreement fails
real_share_execution.buy_cash_reserve: limit-price notional plus commission, slippage, handling, transfer and impact at participation=1; no stamp duty; actual unused reserve remains cash
real_share_execution.execution_inputs: 12.0 signal-date ADV20 and vol63/sqrt(252) plus only the causally prior Diemeng windows declared above; minute data cannot change target identity
real_share_execution.missing_signal_execution_input: a historical residual with missing signal ADV20 or vol63 receives executable capacity zero and an explicit blocked order while valid marks continue; missing inputs can never be imputed from t+1 or a later signal
real_share_execution.capacity: for each ticker/session, cumulative absolute A+B+C executed notional cannot exceed 5% of signal ADV20; each individual window also cannot exceed 5% of that exact window amount_rmb
real_share_execution.blocked_buy: missing required window, zero window liquidity, proven suspension, or whole-window one-price limit-up; residual cash and no substitute
real_share_execution.blocked_sell: missing required window, zero window liquidity, proven suspension, or whole-window one-price limit-down; old position carries
real_share_execution.daily_missing_bar: carry only with attested suspend_d state; otherwise fail
real_share_execution.intraday_resume_open: when suspend_d has an R event whose timing does not prove resumed by 09:30, a held ticker may have a raw daily bar but no 09:30 minute anchor; carry the prior mark through the raw-open boundary, let each A/B/C partition independently prove later tradability, and use the raw daily close at day end; the same no-anchor state without this exact resume proof fails
real_share_execution.delist: zero recovery on the first official session on or after effective delist_date unless a separately frozen recovery source exists

same_session_event_order: validate every economic holding/entitlement raw daily open against the Diemeng 09:30 opening evidence before using it; only a proven zero-liquidity flat pre-close placeholder may mismatch without replacing raw daily open; 09:30 volume is never execution capacity; the final sentinel performs this mark proof but no A/B/C trade
raw-open mark existing settled and pending shares
accrue every ex-date receivable and floored pending-share entitlement from its own frozen record snapshot
settle pay-date receivables into cash and release share-arrival pending lots into settled positions; same-open cash is available to the later rebalance
apply effective delist write-down while preserving already confirmed cash receivables and preventing later pending-share revival
attribute all preceding mutations to the old period and finalize raw-open pretrade NAV
freeze new signal PIT groups and open the new period
after every role has frozen context, execute every role's target-zero full exits in lockstep window A ending 09:35; only after all A observations at 09:36 mark and size reductions
execute every role's partial reductions in lockstep over 09:37..09:41; only after all B observations at 09:42 settle proceeds, mark and size buys
execute every role's cash-scaled buys in lockstep over 09:43..09:47; after all C observations at 09:48 post every intraday mark and trade cost to each new period
after all opening trades and close marks, freeze record-date entitlements from settled positions only

pnl_attribution.period_boundary: this signal next-open pretrade NAV to next signal next-open pretrade NAV
pnl_attribution.old_period_close_order: apply next-boundary corporate actions and raw-open marks, attribute them to the old period, then finalize before any new trade
pnl_attribution.new_period_open_order: freeze new PIT group map at raw-open NAV, then apply causal windows A/B/C; assign all raw-open-to-window marks and ticker costs to the new period before raw close
pnl_attribution.ticker_net_pnl: raw position and pending-share mark change plus receivable economic change minus ticker trade costs and delist loss; principal cash transfers are not P&L
pnl_attribution.market_state: four quadrants of signal-date universe median long/short momentum relative to zero; exact zero is nonpositive
pnl_attribution.market_state_limit: the strategy normally holds stocks only in both_positive; other quadrants validate cash/residual behavior and cannot support a cross-state stock-alpha claim
pnl_attribution.required_reconciliation: sum ticker/group net P&L divided by period-start NAV equals account period return within 1e-8
pnl_attribution.dimension_reconciliation: industry, size and market_state are three separate mutually-exclusive partitions; each dimension must independently sum to ticker net P&L within 1e-8 and dimensions are never added to one another
pnl_attribution.daily_posting_reconciliation: for every role/session, end_nav - start_nav equals the exact sum of raw-mark, ex-entitlement, trade-cost and delist postings within RMB 1e-8; principal, pay and share-list transfers are zero-P&L
pnl_attribution.unknown_group_policy: retain explicit UNKNOWN; never drop or reassign after observing return

phase_metric_contract.quarterly_period_return: next signal pretrade NAV / current signal pretrade NAV - 1
phase_metric_contract.minute_fill_ratio: sum(executed_shares * causally frozen decision_price) / sum(full causally known target_gap_notional before lot rounding, missing-reference blocking, capacity or cash scaling), bounded in [0,1]; execution VWAP is not used in the numerator or denominator
phase_metric_contract.actual_start_weight: ticker market value at window-C close divided by window-C-close account NAV; period return still begins at raw-open boundary NAV

selection_segments.full: all complete selection periods ending no later than 2024-12-31

phase_gate_applied_identically_to_develo.sufficient_exposure_industry_definition: at least 4 invested period boundaries and at least 1% mean actual start weight across invested periods
phase_gate_applied_identically_to_develo.sufficient_exposure_industry_positive_fr: for candidate_base and candidate_stress separately, count sufficient industries with cumulative actual net P&L > 0 divided by all sufficient industries; require >= 0.60
phase_gate_applied_identically_to_develo.leave_one_industry_out_positive_fraction: for candidate_base and candidate_stress separately, remove each sufficient industry's cumulative P&L from total cumulative P&L; positive remainder count divided by sufficient industry count must be >= 0.80
phase_gate_applied_identically_to_develo.market_state_non_both_positive_behavior: target must be empty, no buy may execute, and any actual stock exposure must be an explicitly blocked residual position whose P&L remains reconciled
phase_gate_applied_identically_to_develo.max_drawdown: mandatory disclosure only; 12.0 observed -40.0529% is an unresolved known risk

closure.pre_return_structural_smoke_first_failur: held factor jump lacks primary action: 300495.SZ on 2019-07-12

rejected_5min_candidate_capture.rejection_reason: 09:35 aggregate includes 09:30 auction before post-open company-action settlement, and provider volume regimes are not globally constant

rejected_v2_unit_candidate_capture.rejection_reason: v2 incorrectly used the price-only 09:30 auction amount/volume for unit validation; all 17 continuous 09:31..09:47 bars pass unchanged strict v3 validation

rejected_v3_unit_candidate_capture.rejection_reason: v3 still validated unused 09:42 decision-overlap amount/volume; every one of the 15 consumed A/B/C execution bars passes unchanged strict v4 validation

rejected_v4_unit_candidate_capture.rejection_reason: v4 validated individual minute VWAPs even though execution consumes only three five-minute aggregates; all A/B/C aggregate VWAPs were strictly inside aggregate OHLC and v5 retains all raw geometry/zero-state checks
